meta.purpose: Test whether the skill CHANGES its dominant reading when the SAME sentence appears in different contexts (context-sensitivity of understanding).
meta.method: One sentence, 3 contexts. A KB-only agent produces, per context, >=2 candidate readings + confidence + the single most-likely reading. Pass per case if (a) >=2 readings are listed, (b) the dominant reading matches the expected label, (c) >=1 context slot is used explicitly. Pass per sentence if the 3 dominant readings are NOT all identical.
meta.grade_us: labels: literal/neutral | angry | disappointed_tired | reluctant_forced | guarded | dismissive
